description: 臺北市人行陸橋資訊 [roads, bridges and tunnels] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 臺北市政府工務局新建工程處. 臺北市人行陸橋資訊json file格式檔案，內容包含人行陸橋名稱、人行陸橋編號、認養狀況、轄下機關、所在區鄉、設計單位、監造單位、施工單位、點位座標等資訊。. Coverage: 臺北市政府工務局新建工程處. The portal files it under the publisher 臺北市政府工務局新建工程處. Its tags are 公共資訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in json. The portal shows 2026-09-22 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
